answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases thus burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the anchor deposit is held in the voyage escrow, the tide audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 56 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. The deposit is 55 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
